Feature: Speciality and Doctor Management
  Background:
    As an administrator of the VCMSP03 system,
    I manage specialities and doctors within the healthcare system.

  Scenario: Display exception when Speciality does not exist with Speciality Id
    Given there is no Speciality with the given Speciality Id
    When attempting to access the speciality details
    Then an exception error message "Speciality does not exist" should be displayed

  Scenario: Access Administrators Menu to Add Doctors
    Given the Administrators Menu is accessible
    When choosing to add a new Doctor
    Then the Doctor Id should be generated and a new Doctor record should be created
    And the Doctor Name, Age, Sex, and Qualification fields should be populated

  Scenario: Access Administrators Menu to Edit/Update Doctors
    Given the Administrators Menu is accessible
    When choosing to edit/update an existing Doctor
    And the Doctor Id is provided
    When entering new or modified details for Doctor Name, Age, Sex, Experience, and Qualification
    Then the Doctor record should be updated successfully

    Given there is no Doctor with the given Doctor Id
